boundary.book: Python Platform / ticknet matcher · synthetic depth only · report timing here is a declared illustration, not historical queue reconstruction.
boundary.cost: Python Platform minute owner · synthetic cash reconciliation · opportunity shortfall is descriptive, never a second cash fee.
boundary.flow: Implemented in Rust Engine · synthetic quote/accounting conformance · no strategy-performance evidence.
boundary.impact: Python Platform LinearImpact · synthetic sensitivity · coefficients uncalibrated; the reference has zero nondecaying component.
boundary.lots: Python Platform discrete inventory solver · exhaustive optimum only within this tiny declared grid · no general nonconvex guarantee.
boundary.paths: Python Platform minute execution · independently rerun accounts and feedback · synthetic paths, no additional independent real-market samples.
boundary.risk: Python Platform financial checkpoints, restrictions and allocation · synthetic acceptance · Runtime process recovery has separate evidence; no executable liquidation claim.
boundary.selection: Public null-signal generator + finite teaching enumeration · six retained attempts · not PBO/CSCV and not a real out-of-sample result.
diagram.embedded: Impact is already included in gross payment.
diagram.grid: Solid = feasible · ring = selected · dashed = infeasible
diagram.onebudget: One market fill · one fee · one impact update
diagram.trials: Trial number · ring marks the selected maximum
motion: Motion starts only when you press Play. Reduced-motion preference keeps manual steps. Leaving the scene pauses it.

scenario.once: One physical fill, one cash debit
scenario.residual: Locked day and limited exit capacity
scenario.shared: Two sleeves share one liquidity budget
units.actions: CNY cash, cash rights, wealth and external capital; shares and stock rights in shares; ISO session date or explicit receipt time.
units.book: Synthetic currency/share prices and currency payments; shares; elapsed milliseconds.
units.cost: CNY cash, gross payment, fees and embedded impact cost; shares; UTC nanoseconds.
units.flow: USD cash and fees; shares; USD/share prices; UTC nanoseconds.
units.impact: Price and displacement in CNY/share; signed shares; elapsed seconds.
units.lots: CNY cash and fees; whole shares; squared-share tracking error; one decision at clock zero.
units.paths: CNY cash; shares; target weight as a fraction; UTC nanoseconds.
units.recovery: CNY cash; shares; clock is the checkpoint event-boundary index, not elapsed time.
units.residual: CNY cash and marked wealth; residual shares; ISO session date.
units.risk-full: One-day forecast variance and squared residual in bps²; variance ratio and coverage are dimensionless; ISO UTC target/as-of clocks.
units.risk-missing: One-day variance in bps²; coverage is paired rows / forecast rows; absent outcomes stay unknown; ISO UTC clocks.
units.selection: Return fractions, not percentages; clock is the zero-based trial index.
units.shared: CNY cash, gross payment, fees and embedded impact; shares; UTC nanoseconds.
